references.text: The same song speaks of the Lord's righteous acts and his rule over Israel
Samuel speaks of the Lord's righteous acts toward Israel; the same expression is used
Describes the people gathering at the wells and singing praises to the Lord
The Lord's righteousness and righteous acts for the oppressed
Micah urges Israel to remember the Lord's righteous acts
Describes the Lord's righteousness and judgments that he carries out for Israel
The people enter through the gates, a similar image of the Lord's people going down to the gates
